source.base_subject: perf: promote Decode FP8 output sidecar
source.candidate_scope: test-only kernel template instance and synthetic screening harness

current_stage_target.profile_note: The earlier post-GDN profile ranked fused NVFP4 down at 20.913505 ms per Decode step. That profile predates the FP8 output-sidecar production promotion, so it is context rather than a current attribution claim.

candidate.phase: exact M1 Decode fused down projection, residual add, and centered RMSNorm
candidate.baseline: production cooperative 64-CTA kernel; after its grid sync all 64 CTAs repeat the RMS reduction and only CTAs 0 through 19 publish normalized 256-row slices
candidate.mechanism: retain the complete 64-CTA projection, BF16 raw and residual boundaries, and cooperative grid sync, then return CTAs 20 through 63 before the repeated centered-RMS reduction
candidate.numerical_contract: projection mapping, accumulation order, raw BF16 rounding, residual BF16 rounding, grid synchronization, RMS summation order within every surviving CTA, inverse RMS, gamma, and normalized BF16 rounding remain unchanged
candidate.fixture_scope: deterministic packed-weight pattern with checkpoint-like and same-bank-stress scale distributions plus mixed finite activation, residual, and norm-weight inputs

environment.comparison_scope: one same-process, same-binary synthetic exact-shape screen
environment.clock_note: The retained synthetic log does not embed independent clock, thermal, or power readbacks.

performance_protocol.comparison: production fused baseline versus direct test-only post-grid-sync CTA-pruned candidate
performance_protocol.selection_statistic: median of the five paired per-round (B1+B2)/(C1+C2) speedups
performance_protocol.stop_loss: reject before actual-checkpoint, NCU, model-oracle, and end-to-end work if either synthetic distribution misses its frozen median gate

sass.interpretation: The candidate preserves the production resource and instruction-count envelope. The only intended semantic change is the CTA-uniform exit after the cooperative grid sync; the measured benefit remains below the frozen gate.

decision.reason: Both synthetic distributions are bit-exact and every paired round is non-regressing, but checkpoint-like reaches only 1.00135x and same-bank stress only 1.00107x against the required 1.002x paired median.
decision.closed_scope: post-grid-sync exit of the 44 CTAs that do not publish normalized output, while preserving the 64-CTA projection and cooperative barrier
decision.mechanism_interpretation: Eliminating redundant post-sync reductions saves only about 0.10 percent per fused kernel; the arithmetic 64-layer effect is roughly 0.02 ms/token, too small to justify deeper validation or production complexity.
not_run: actual checkpoint weight and block-scale payload

follow_up.next_priority: capture a fresh P19/C32/max26 production Decode profile after the FP8 output-sidecar promotion, then re-rank phase-local kernel opportunities from that current timeline
follow_up.do_not_restore: Do not restore this CTA-prune candidate or continue to actual-checkpoint and end-to-end gates without a materially different mechanism.

limitations: This is a synthetic mechanism screen, not an actual-checkpoint measurement.
The retained log proves same-process relative timings but does not embed independent clock, thermal, power, or energy evidence.
The 64-layer deltas are arithmetic projections from one isolated fused-kernel pass and are not achieved end-to-end savings.
No causal NCU counter study or fresh post-sidecar Decode profile is attached to the rejection.
The expected nonzero test exit reflects the two frozen performance-gate failures and overall selection failure, not a correctness, resource, or Graph failure.
